lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nine pages and five signatures, on the morning of the vote, to four outlets at once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pooling happens anyway. It was always going to. But it happens under a document that everyone has now read, and every attempt to close it again for the next three centuries has to explain itself to a public that has seen the original.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: It is still theirs. I want to be honest about that. It is just theirs in daylight now, and daylight is not nothing. Daylight is most of what I have.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century there is a line in the charter that nobody can source. There is going to be a source now.
